D/ IMP CLAVDIVS AVG ; R/ GENIVS EXERCI

A copper alloy Roman radiate of Claudius II (AD 268-270), 'GENIUS EXERCI' reverse type depicting Genius standing left, holding patera and cornucopia. Rome mint dating to AD268-270 (Reece period 13); Cunetio (137: 2150). Obverse: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP CLAVDIVS AVG. Reverse: Genius standing left, holding patera and cornucopia. Reverse inscription: GENIVS EXERCI. Dimensions: diameter: 19.71mm; weight: 1.10g. Another Claudius II radiate of this type on the database is BM-6710F1
